title: Add video fixture extraction preflight

context.summary: Make the integration video scenario robust when the host ffmpeg available in CI cannot extract frames from the embedded MP4 fixture.
context.background: TASK-116 removed ffmpeg encoder dependency from the fixture setup. GitHub CI then reached worker processing but timed out waiting for video chunking, while the same ffmpeg path passed locally.

in: Preflight host ffmpeg against the embedded MP4 fixture before selecting the integration video provider.
Use the real ffmpeg provider when the current environment can extract frames.
Use a deterministic manifest video fixture when host ffmpeg cannot process the embedded MP4 in that environment.
Keep the video upload/search/assertion flow active in both modes.
Validate tasks and repository checks before merge.
out: Changing release signing or GitHub repository settings.
Changing the public release version number.

acceptance_criteria: The integration video test preflights ffmpeg extraction before selecting the ffmpeg provider.
The ffmpeg provider remains covered when host ffmpeg can extract frames from the embedded fixture.
The manifest provider keeps video upload/search integration covered when host ffmpeg is unsuitable.
Task registry includes TASK-117 and validates.
pnpm check passes locally before merge.

manual_checks: Confirm GitHub CI failure after TASK-116 timed out waiting for video document chunking.

risks: GitHub release may reveal a later publishing-only issue after repository checks pass.
definition_of_done: Branch is committed and merged back into master.
